$comment: Cue F of the score. The only forward motion.
title: The Turn

musical.notes: The only cue in the score that moves forward, and even here it does not celebrate: this is relief, and the relief buys four more years. Should enter under the last held violin note of cue E, so the turn is felt before it is heard.

provenance.prompt: Instrumental underscore, 76 BPM, D minor leaning toward F major. Strings gather from a single line into a slow forward pulse; piano and harp beneath; the three-note figure inverted so that it rises instead of falling. Motion returning after long stillness — urgent, hopeful, but never triumphant. Ends mid-phrase, still climbing, unresolved.
provenance.excludes: fanfare, triumphant, heroic, choir, vocals, snare drum, epic trailer, drums

notes: The Marne, 5–12 September. Hands off to cue G by refusing to arrive: cut the climb off and let the drone take the same pitch, so the listener notices the promise is not kept.
